cards.name: Bissell Little Green (1400B)
cards.buy_if: you have pets, kids, a couch, car seats or stairs — anything you can't put in a washing machine.
cards.skip_if: you need whole-room carpet cleaning, or years-old set-in stains.
cards.owners: Praise: the before-and-after on a 'clean' couch. Complaints: loud as a shop vac, a short 4-foot hose, tanks that need drying.
cards.video_title: 6 years with the Bissell Little Green — a long-term review

cards.name: Bissell Little Green Mini (4075)
cards.chip: 7 lb · 4-inch tool · fits a closet shelf
cards.buy_if: you live in an apartment, or mostly clean car seats and small spots.
cards.skip_if: you have big rugs — the tank is small and refills add up.
cards.owners: Praise: the size and the price. Complaint: refills on big jobs.

cards.name: Hoover CleanSlate Plus
cards.buy_if: you want a longer hose and a system that rinses itself.
cards.skip_if: you want the smallest, cheapest spot cleaner.
cards.owners: CNN Underscored's most convenient carpet cleaner. Complaint: heavier than the Little Green.
